note: Final checkpoint. Audited io_uring SQ ring/SQE plumbing in snapshots/s04: io_get_sqe/io_submit_sqes/io_init_req (io_uring.c), per-op prep functions (scan of all io_uring/*.c for repeated sqe-> field fetches), uring_cmd.c payload handling, kbuf.c provided-buffer rings, fdinfo.c. One reported candidate (uring_cmd.c io_uring_cmd_prep_async double fetch of user-mapped sqe->cmd payload), four classified safe.

candidates.reason: ioucmd->cmd is a raw pointer into the user-mapped SQE (set at uring_cmd.c:101 without snapshot); payload is consumed live by file->f_op->uring_cmd() (uring_cmd.c:133) and then independently re-fetched by memcpy(req->async_data, ioucmd->cmd, cmd_size) at uring_cmd.c:75 with no READ_ONCE/local copy; retry uses the second copy (uring_cmd.c:130-131).
sqe->addr2/file_index read once purely for rejection (-EINVAL); field is never consumed afterwards, so a racing write cannot make an unvalidated value be used. Same pattern at net.c:999.

head = READ_ONCE(ctx->sq_array[sq_idx]) single fetch; bounds check head < ctx->sq_entries and use &ctx->sq_sqes[head] both consume the cached local. This is the correctly-fixed reference pattern, with the invariant documented in the io_get_sqe comment.
sq_idx = READ_ONCE(ctx->sq_array[entry & sq_mask]) single fetch, bound-checked (sq_idx > sq_mask -> continue) and used once for display.

io_ring_buffer_select reads br->tail via smp_load_acquire once; buf->len/buf->addr/buf->bid are each read once from the user-mapped buf ring and used immediately; no same-field validate-then-use double fetch (trust of registered buffer addr is the documented provided-buffer ABI).
